sn35.61:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the Dhamma for the exhaustion of all clinging.
sn35.61:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma for the exhaustion of all clinging?
sn35.61:1.4: In dependence on the eye and forms, eye-consciousness arises….
sn35.61:1.7: With its deliverance he understands: ‘Clinging has been exhausted by me.’
sn35.61:1.8: “In dependence on the ear and sounds …
sn35.61:1.9: the mind and mental phenomena, mind-consciousness arises….
sn35.61:1.12: With its deliverance he understands: ‘Clinging has been exhausted by me.’
sn35.61:1.13: “This, bhikkhus, is the Dhamma for the exhaustion of all clinging.”
